provenance.robot: Franka Robotics franka_simulation v0.1.0 FR3 v2.1 USD; variant explicitly differs from earlier Menagerie model
provenance.connector: External envelope reference FH12; slot, latch and insertion depth are design assumptions, not manufacturing CAD
provenance.cable: Native homogeneous surface FEM or discrete compliant ribbon selected per run; all mechanics uncalibrated, not a validated laminate or electrical model
provenance.suction: No pressure/flow solver. Optional attachment surrogate must be explicitly requested; disabled by default

shell.provenance: Uncalibrated effective homogeneous laminate. No resolved copper conductors or end stiffener in shell mode. Sweep required.
